rationale: Adds a process-lifetime cache for immutable embedded PNG bytes used by the native Nodal editor. The source-rectangle draw now decodes and uploads a static image once per backend, preserving pixel output while removing repeated per-frame decode. Pulp continues to own this editable canvas target under the 2026-10-04 design-import refactor inheritance decision; Vellum inherits this generic cache when that target adopts the Vellum package. No source-routing or authority boundary moves.
